description: A PLATEAU-shaped LOD2 building whose lod2Solid is nothing but xlink:href references to its boundary surfaces' polygons. The reader resolves each reference into the face it names, so the writer meets every one of the four surfaces twice; each is written in full once, under the boundary surface that names it a ground, a roof or a wall, and the solid's shell is four gml:surfaceMember elements carrying xlink:href instead of a second copy of the coordinates. New-world only: the legacy writer flattens nested objects onto their feature.
